annotations.title: Set the GolfCore API monthly budget

description: Set the monthly request ceiling on a Basic or Business GolfCore API account. Requests past the included amount are billed at the plan's overage rate up to this ceiling, then refused until the month resets. Read the allowed range (included to max_hard_limit) from api_account, and confirm the number and what it could cost with the person first.
name: api_budget
